Aiming Down Sights for #e${1.5-#d} seconds without firing grants the following for a single shot:
• 10% increased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• 40% increased precision damage (35% for <<primary/>Scout Rifles, 30% for <heavy/>Heavy Ammo Sniper Rifles)

Timer starts as soon as the ADS input is pressed. Unscoping immediately removes the buff.

For glaives (Greasy Luck), the projectile must strike the target's critical hitbox in order to recieve the 40% <pvp [35%] /> damage bonus. 

//The precision damage of Scout Rifles is decreased by 5% while Box Breathing is active. (This part of the perk is inconsistent and often doesn't get applied).
